Research standard: screen at least three precisely formulated candidates from distinct mechanisms, with early actual-primary prior-art and source-companion audit. Choose strongest viable candidate, develop at least two genuinely distinct proof constructions, press through all unpaid interfaces. New-to-report standard transfers, equivalently restated source operations, qualitative compactness, basic tensorization/finite replication, or method counterexamples do not count. Avoid polishing a weak technical result instead of attempting missing bridge. If complete candidate, exact hypotheses/conclusion/full proof/dependencies/novelty limits and adversarial checks. If unresolved, precise strongest proved partial/unpaid estimate and actual examples, not renamed target-as-lemma. Numerical diagnostics never universal proof. Identify relevant MathDB/open problem and observed significance if accessible; never invent a score. No external theorem automatically true merely because recent or AI-assisted.
Parked work exclusions: SK fair-start density, Haldane bond disorder, transport transverse redistribution, Saxl coverage, geometric/supergeometric avoidance, elementary unimodality/no-MCM, and routine consequences of the seven accepted findings. Read ledger to avoid duplicating old screens.

Main starting family A-sharp-entropy-bound-and-the-simplex-inequality-for-isotropic-constants-October-5-2026. Parent read actual introduction.tex: entropy h(f)>=m+.5logdetCov(f), equality affine independent one-sided exponentials; simplex maximizes isotropic constant; nonlinear affine normalization E[q^-1(D²phi)]=0; retained slack controls nonlinear Gaussian chaos Y and sum Xr²-I; equality compatibility of q(sum xrXr) forces commuting Xr. Read ALL actual scalar/matrix/transport/rigidity/approximation/geometry operations and relevant corpus companions. All source proofs true; proving its already-contained equality or Mahler consequence is no finding.
Promising genuine gap may be quantitative stability of covariance-normalized log-concave laws toward translated/rotated exponential products, or simplex stability, but screen three precise targets/metrics first. In isotropic centered coordinates the equality laws are O(E-1), O orthogonal; use distance to this WHOLE class, not fixed orientation. Investigate dimension-uniform normalized W2 or entropy control where plausible, or a meaningful explicit fixed-dimension power with a truly new bridge. No claim of global TV/KL control from W2 without proof; moving one-sided supports can make directed KL infinite. Do not hide normalization condition numbers, tail errors, matrix commutator dimension dependence or support approximation constants. Source q is Lipschitz but q^-1 is not globally uniform: check all uses. Generic fixed-dimension finite-matrix Lojasiewicz followed by already-proved compactness may be technical; show what is new before nomination.
Potential constructions: quantitative integrability of nearly linear matrix fields and almost commuting coefficient families; robust affine normalization and Gaussian transport truncation; cone reduction from functional to body stability with dimension losses fully tracked. At least two genuine mechanisms for strongest target. Prior-art search must read current Fradelizi–Marin Sola, Melbourne–Nayar–Roberto, sharp entropy stability and simplex/isotropic local stability actual statements/proofs, and existing almost-commuting self-adjoint matrix stability. Do not claim dimension-free approximants without addressing known matrix obstacles. R013 logBM stability is available as accepted but mere corollaries of it count within R013. This task seeks a distinct mechanism, not a relabeling of its moment-product proof.
